entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit. Your call is important to us. Please hold for the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. You've reached VeloFit, my name is Isaac. How can I help you today?
Hi... I hope you can help. I ordered a jersey and I think I need to send it back. I was looking at the website and I just got really overwhelmed.
I can certainly look into that for you. To get started, could I please have your name and order number?
Yes, it's Maria Valenti. The order number is... uh... VF-655-8021.
Thank you, Maria. I see your order here for the ProFit Jersey. To make sure I'm helping you correctly, what specifically is the issue? Is it a technical fault or more of a preference with the fit?
Oh no, it's not damaged. It's just the wrong size for me. It's really too tight across the shoulders. I was hoping to do an exchange, but the process seemed so complicated. Can't you just help me?
Of course, Maria. That's what I'm here for. Let me just confirm the delivery date... It looks like it was delivered 43 days ago. Please hold one moment while I review the return eligibility.
Alright, thank you for your patience. I've checked our policy, and you are well within the 90-day return window. We can definitely process a full refund for you.
Oh, that's great! So it's not a problem that I've had it for over a month?

Not at all. I have already approved the return in our system. I'm emailing you a pre-paid shipping label right now. Simply print that out, attach it to your return package, and drop it off. Once our warehouse receives the jersey, your refund will be processed.
Wow, that's so much easier. Thank you so much, Isaac. You've been a huge help.
You're very welcome, Maria. Is there anything else I can assist with today?
My pleasure. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a wonderful day.
